description: This file handles the deletion of a note entity within the vtiger CRM system. It retrieves the current module instance, verifies the presence of a record to delete, performs the delete operation, and redirects the user accordingly.

classes.name: CRMEntity

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of CRMEntity corresponding to the current module.
